sites.name: Mount Xumi Grottoes
sites.what: Grottoes near Guyuan. The Chinese government submitted this location on a 2008 UNESCO tentative list; that list is an index, not proof of World Heritage inscription or current visitor access.

ancient-sites-and-mysteries.summary: 1 site(s) recorded. Recent entries use UNESCO heritage descriptions or, where stated, a tentative-list index; visitor access still needs checking.

laws.rule: Visitors must follow safety warning rules and the safety directions of guides and scenic-area staff (article 38).
laws.penalty_signal: No fine on the visitor is set in the article read; breaches fall under the other laws that apply.
